metadata.description: Plugin marketplace for the Open Agent AI Security community, serving Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Add once, install any community plugin.

plugins.name: praxen
plugins.description: Praxen — agent behavior verifier. Compares an agent's declared policy against the available evidence (source, deployment state, or behavioral artifacts); reports where observed behavior diverges from declared intent.

plugins.name: praxen-beta
plugins.description: Praxen 2.0 BETA — pre-release channel served from the praxen-beta mirror repo (tracks praxen's v2-beta branch; evidence-derived threat modeling). Installs in place of the production praxen plugin; reinstall praxen to return to stable. Beta docs: https://open-agent-ai-security.github.io/praxen/beta/

plugins.name: socxen
plugins.description: socxen — agentic SOC analyst. Triages Exabeam New-Scale alerts and cases end to end via the Exabeam MCP: gathers evidence, correlates activity, reaches a threat/false-positive verdict, and acts — containment recommended for human approval, and dismiss/close gated by Claude Code permission rules.
